summary: Both Vitest gates passed. AC1 and AC3 have confirmed defects, and the AC2 call-site test passes despite a missing replacement. The TypeScript run found one track-owned error.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] review-a: src/apk3d/sim/copy.ts:66-73 drops trailing holes from arrays and fails to preserve an own enumerable `__proto__` key. A sparse array of length 4 with only index 1 set returns length 2. A parsed object with an own `__proto__` key loses that key. Both values survive native cloning. Preserve array length and define copied keys as own data properties. Add regression cases for both inputs.

F2 [Blocker] review-a: tests/apk3d/no-unpolyfilled-builtins.test.ts:100-135,212-230,287-298 misses valid unsupported calls. The regex heuristic strips `origin / structuredClone(value) / 2` as a regex and misses a call after `if (ok) /"/.test(s)`. The call patterns miss `rows.at(getLastIndex())`, `notthis.at(-1)`, `itemsz.union(other)`, and `structuredClone /* note */ (value)`. The Box3 exclusion also hides unrelated calls on the same line. Distinguish calls from regex literals, match the named receivers exactly, and bind each exclusion to its call. Add positive controls for all 19 labels.

F3 [Blocker] review-a: tests/old-browser/index-math.test.ts:58-67 checks for a helper anywhere in each file, not at each of the nine sites. Removing the helper from Storytime's version selection left the case green because two other calls remain in that file. Require the expected call at each distinct site and prove the case fails when one is absent.

F4 [Blocker] review-a: plan.md:205-207 claims no TypeScript error in a changed file. The compiler exits 2 and reports TS2769 at tests/old-browser/deep-copy.test.ts:101 in the Object.keys call. Red added this test after the phase base. Fix the narrowing without weakening the state-type check. Record the phase base separately from the Red-to-Green comparison.
nonblocking_findings: F5 [Nit] review-a: The new Phase 2 evidence in plan.md:168-235 fails Prettier although the Red plan passes. T5 also calls all 37 touched paths source files; the total includes the scan test. Format the new plan evidence and record 36 source files plus the scan test.

F6 [Nit] review-a: src/apk3d/sim/copy.ts:25-61 uses realm-specific instanceof checks. A cross-realm typed array of length one copies as length zero, and a cross-realm promise does not throw. The current simulations create their state in one realm. State that limit or add parity for other realms.
F7 [Nit] review-a: T5 adds a second import from the same simulation barrel in 33 changed game files. One example is src/games/abyssal-well/core/sim.ts:17-18. Add the helper to the existing import.
